definitions.explanation: The act of directing toward a target, or the target itself.
What one hopes to achieve or the goal behind an action.

examples.japanese: {狙|ねら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{定|さだ}めて→定める：10448_sadameru⟧⟦{撃|う}った→打つ：01221_utsu⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{政策|せいさく}→政策：10070_seisaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{狙|ねら}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{何|なん}→何：00498_nani⟧ですか。
examples.english: What is the aim of this policy?

examples.japanese: {狙|ねら}いどおり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いった→行く：00119_iku⟧。
{狙|ねら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{外|はず}さず→外す：02394_hazusu⟧、⟦{的|まと}→的：19356_mato⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{当|あ}てた→当てる：01864_ateru⟧。
examples.english: Without missing the aim, I hit the center of the target.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{狙|ねら}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{銀行|ぎんこう}→銀行：00578_ginkou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{金庫|きんこ}→金庫：01749_kinko⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The criminal's target was the bank vault.

examples.japanese: ⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦{制度|せいど}→制度：03291_seido⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{狙|ねら}い⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{若者|わかもの}→若者：03037_wakamono⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{支援|しえん}する→支援：07778_shien⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The aim of the new system is to support young people in finding employment.

notes:
{狙|ねら}い is the noun form of the verb ⟦{狙|ねら}う→狙う：00313_nerau⟧ (to aim at), referring to both physical targeting and abstract objectives.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {狙|ねら}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{定|さだ}める→定める：10448_sadameru⟧ (to take aim)
- {狙|ねら}い⟦どおり→どおり：09884_doori⟧ (as intended/planned)
- {狙|ねら}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧ (to miss the mark)
- ～の{狙|ねら}い (the aim of ~)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{狙|ねら}い{撃|う}ち→狙い撃ち：18924_neraiuchi⟧: Targeted attack, sniping
- ⟦{狙|ねら}い{目|め}→狙い目：27426_neraime⟧: Target, good opportunity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {狙|ねら}い vs. ⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧: ⟦{目的|もくてき}→目的：02433_mokuteki⟧ is a more formal word for "purpose" or "objective"; {狙|ねら}い emphasizes the targeting or strategic aspect.
- {狙|ねら}い vs. ⟦{意図|いと}→意図：12625_ito⟧: ⟦{意図|いと}→意図：12625_ito⟧ means "intention" with a nuance of deliberate planning.

Register: Neutral. Used in both concrete (shooting) and abstract (policy) contexts.
